note: Glue module between EU Cookie Compliance and Matomo. It injects a JS snippet driving Matomo's _paq consent API (requireConsent/disableCookies/setConsentGiven) based on the EU Cookie Compliance consent cookie. Its ONLY config is eu_cookie_compliance_matomo.settings.categories (array of cookie-category machine names required for Matomo consent; shipped default []). Because the banner and tracking belong to the other two modules and involve a hosted-analytics setup, all medium/hard cases are grounded in this LOCAL config object only (no live tracking calls). Configure route eu_cookie_compliance_matomo.settings -> /admin/config/system/eu-cookie-compliance/matomo (permission 'administer eu cookie compliance popup' from EU Cookie Compliance). Verify reads categories the way the module does (truthy values), so indexed or checkbox-array storage both pass.

evals.prompt: What does the eu_cookie_compliance_matomo Drupal module do, and which two modules does it require?
evals.expected_output: It bridges EU Cookie Compliance and Matomo so Matomo only tracks after cookie consent, using Matomo's _paq consent API (requireConsent / setConsentGiven). It requires the eu_cookie_compliance and matomo modules.

evals.prompt: How does eu_cookie_compliance_matomo stop Matomo from tracking before the visitor consents? Name the Matomo _paq command it pushes.
evals.expected_output: It injects JS that, when the EU Cookie Compliance consent cookie shows no consent, calls _paq.push(['requireConsent']) (and _paq.push(['disableCookies']) unless Matomo already disables cookies). On agreeing it calls _paq.push(['setConsentGiven']).

evals.prompt: Where is eu_cookie_compliance_matomo configured, and what is the single setting it exposes?
evals.expected_output: At /admin/config/system/eu-cookie-compliance/matomo. Its only setting is 'categories' (eu_cookie_compliance_matomo.settings.categories) - the cookie categories that must be agreed for Matomo consent in opt-in-with-categories mode.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has eu_cookie_compliance_matomo configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which cookie categories must be agreed before Matomo is given consent.
Inspect this site's eu_cookie_compliance_matomo configuration and state exactly which cookie category (or categories) it requires for Matomo consent.
evals.expected_output: The categories setting is ['ecc_social_media'] - a single required category.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the eu_cookie_compliance_matomo module so that Matomo consent requires the visitor to have agreed to BOTH the 'analytics' and 'marketing' cookie categories. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set eu_cookie_compliance_matomo.settings.categories to include 'analytics' and 'marketing' (e.g. via the form checkboxes at /admin/config/system/eu-cookie-compliance/matomo, or by writing the categories array in config).

evals.prompt: This site's eu_cookie_compliance_matomo module currently requires an outdated cookie category ('legacy_cat') for Matomo consent. Change it so Matomo consent instead requires only the 'analytics' category, and the old one is no longer required. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Replace the categories value so it contains 'analytics' and no longer 'legacy_cat' (set eu_cookie_compliance_matomo.settings.categories to ['analytics']).
